title: PostgreSQL logical replication can write to subscriber system catalogs, executing arbitrary code (CVE-2026-120145)
description: A vulnerability in PostgreSQL logical replication allows a compromised publisher to execute arbitrary code on the subscriber system by naming a system catalog as a replication target. This affects only subscriptions owned by a superuser. Versions prior to PostgreSQL 14.25, 15.20, 16.16, 17.12, and 18.7 are vulnerable.
